description: This Scala source file provides utility classes and objects for converting Java UDFs to Scala functions within Spark SQL, including various adapter methods for different UDF shapes and functional transformations.

classes.name: ToScalaUDF
classes.description: Object providing conversion methods from Java UDF interfaces to Scala functions, including specific wrappers for UDF0 to UDF22.

classes.name: UDFAdaptors
classes.description: Object providing adapter methods to convert between different Spark RDD and DataFrame transformations, such as map, flatMap, and group operations.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Various overloaded methods converting Java UDF interfaces (e.g., UDF0 to UDF22) into Scala function types.

methods.name: flatMapToMapPartitions
methods.description: Converts a function V => IterableOnce[U] or a FlatMapFunction into a function suitable for mapPartitions.

methods.name: mapToMapPartitions
methods.description: Converts a function V => U or a MapFunction into a mapPartitions-compatible function.

methods.name: mapValues
methods.description: Creates key-value pairs from an iterator of IV, applying optional struct wrapping.

methods.name: foreachToForeachPartition
methods.description: Converts a function T => Unit or a ForeachFunction into a foreachPartition-compatible function.

methods.name: foreachPartitionToMapPartitions
methods.description: Wraps a foreach function into a mapPartitions function that returns an empty iterator.

methods.name: iterableOnceToSeq
methods.description: Converts a function A => IterableOnce[B] into A => Seq[B].

methods.name: mapGroupsToFlatMapGroups
methods.description: Wraps a grouping function into an iterator of U.

methods.name: mapGroupsWithStateToFlatMapWithState
methods.description: Wraps a grouped stateful function into an iterator of U.

methods.name: coGroupWithMappedValues
methods.description: Combines two iterators with optional value mapping functions into an iterable of R.

methods.name: flatMapGroupsWithMappedValues
methods.description: Wraps a grouped function with optional value mapping into an iterator of R.

methods.name: flatMapGroupsWithStateWithMappedValues
methods.description: Wraps a stateful grouped function with optional value mapping into an iterator of U.
